function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against record using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing any debt details.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or birth year provided by the caller.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer. Only call this after verification has succeeded.

ptp_date.description: ISO-8601 date agreed for payment, e.g. 2026-08-21

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered number.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes the call/customer to a human agent for cases outside the bot's authority: hardship, dispute, or unresolved abusive behavior.

notes.description: Optional context for the human agent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status. Must be called exactly once before every call ends.
